svg.text: Isolated IVI test — the app alone, its producer mocked
Three nodes on one bridge. The ADA node replays R4 from a scenario file; the IVI node is a Skycraft VM with the team APK installed into it.
replays R4 warnings; no ADA logic runs
on the AAOS 0.0.1 artifact, installed over ADB
one L2 segment · 10.99.0.0/24 · one ethernet pin per node
m1-r4-sim View Log — [TX] lines, one per warning sent, at the configured rate
Guest logcat over ADB — [RX] with source=v2x_relayed, plus the crash buffer; the IVI node's own log is the VM host, not the app
IVI Screen widget — the Warning View with ghost C dashed; the only surface that proves anything rendered
No pcap on this path: m1-r4-sim runs no capture, so its log carries no [CAP] line and no block to extract.
Rows 1 and 2 come from one command — tools\logs-collector\Collect-Logs.ps1 -Test 2, into test-report\ivi-isolated-test\. Row 3 stays manual, in the browser.
The IVI node pulls no image: it boots the AAOS VM artifact from Artifacts, and app-debug.apk is installed into the already-running guest over the ADB tunnel.
